title: 第十八章 水平第十九章 回家
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
十分钟后。
陈洛手持计时器，抵达学校操场。
今年的高温天气，持续时间远超往年。
即便到了十月中旬，温度依旧维持在30度往上。
高温笼罩之下，目光所及之处，皆呈现扭曲的波纹。
陈洛环顾四周。
操场上空无一人，只偶尔能看到零散学生经过。
正方便他进行测试。
第一项测试，是短跑。
来到集训专门规划的地点，陈洛略微活动一番手脚，便直接开始。
拔腿狂奔，直至抵达终点。
看向手中的计时器，时间定格在9秒55.
而目前人类百米冲刺的世界纪录，则是9秒58.
这就，打破世界纪录了？
看着手机页面显示的数据，陈洛表情有些恍惚，总觉得没啥实感。
但细细想来，倒也正常。
他只是个普通大学生，且对于运动比赛，出名装逼什么的，都没啥兴趣。
唯一觉得有意思的，就是感受自己一步步变强的快感。
无须与其他人比较。
只需要确定，自己在变强，便足够了。

想明白这点。
陈洛收起思绪，继续进行测试。
第二个项目，一千五百米长跑。
“呼——”
当略有些气喘的陈洛，停在终点处调整呼吸时，其手中计时器的数字，定格在3分45秒。
这一次，倒是没能打破世界纪录。
但他并不意外。
在长跑中，耐力是最为关键的因素。
而在陈洛目前拥有的词条中，不论是肌肉还是神经强化，都叠加了三条，等级为lv3.
而能够强化心肺功能的脏腑强化，依旧停留在lv2.
测试完自己的爆发速度以及长跑耐力，陈洛依旧觉得不过瘾。
他扭头看向校园另一侧。
大学公共健身房。
想要测试自己目前的力量，那是最适合不过的地方。
于是，十分钟后。
陈洛顺利抵达目的地。
大一和大三的学生，大部分都在上课。
加上天气炎热的因素，健身房除了门口昏昏欲睡的看管大爷，连个鬼影子都见不着，更别说人。
作为大学四年，一次都没有踏足过这里的陈洛，如同刘姥姥进了大观园，看什么都觉得稀奇。
溜达一圈，最终停留在力量区的陈洛，由轻到重，开始一个个拿起哑铃。

十公斤，轻若无物。
content_en:
Ten minutes later.
Chen Luo arrived at the school playground with a timer in hand.
This year's hot weather lasted far longer than in previous years.
Even in mid-October, the temperature still remains above 30 degrees.
Under the high temperature, twisted ripples appear everywhere you look.
Chen Luo looked around.
The playground was deserted, and only a few students could be seen passing by occasionally.
Just in time for him to test.
The first test is sprinting.
Arriving at the specially planned location for the training camp, Chen Luo moved his hands and feet a little and started directly.
Run like crazy until you reach the finish line.
Looking at the timer in his hand, the time was frozen at 9 seconds 55.
The current world record for the 100-meter dash is 9 seconds 58.
Is this a world record breaking?
Looking at the data displayed on the mobile phone page, Chen Luo's expression was a little dazed, and he always felt that there was no real sense.
But if you think about it carefully, it's normal.
He is just an ordinary college student, and he has no interest in sports competitions, being famous or anything like that.
The only thing that is interesting is feeling the pleasure of getting stronger step by step.
No need to compare yourself to others.
Just make sure that you are getting stronger, that's enough.
Figure this out.
Chen Luo put away his thoughts and continued the test.
The second event is the 1,500-meter long-distance race.
"Huh——"
When Chen Luo, who was slightly out of breath, stopped at the finish line to adjust his breathing, the number on the timer in his hand was fixed at 3 minutes and 45 seconds.
This time, he failed to break the world record.
But he wasn't surprised.
In long-distance running, endurance is the most critical factor.
Among the entries currently owned by Chen Luo, whether it is muscle or nerve strengthening, there are three superimposed entries, with a level of lv3.
The strengthening of the internal organs, which can strengthen the cardiopulmonary function, is still at level 2.
After testing his explosive speed and long-distance running endurance, Chen Luo still felt unsatisfied.
He turned to look at the other side of the campus.
University public gym.
If you want to test your current strength, that is the most suitable place.
So, ten minutes later.
Chen Luo arrived at his destination smoothly.
Most of the freshmen and junior students are in class.
Coupled with the hot weather, except for the sleepy caretaker at the door of the gym, there was not even a ghost, let alone a human being.
Chen Luo, who had never set foot here even once during his four years of college, was like Grandma Liu entering the Grand View Garden, feeling strange about everything he saw.
After walking around in a circle, Chen Luo finally stopped in the strength area and started to pick up the dumbbells one by one from light to heavy.
Ten kilograms, as light as nothing.
